ExxonMobil (XOM) was also added to the portfolio with a conviction of 72/100, as it benefits from a favorable energy sector momentum, although we note the risk of negative year-over-year revenue growth. Apple (AAPL) and APP were included with conviction scores of 68/100 and 67/100, respectively, as both show potential for mean reversion; however, AAPL faces increased competition that could pressure margins. Qualcomm (QCOM) was added with a conviction of 66/100, capitalizing on its oversold status and leadership in 5G technology, while being mindful of potential pricing pressures from competitors. We are maintaining our positions in META, AKAM, and CTSH, with further analysis required for the latter two.
